newsitem.title: USA: Breakdown of jobless rate for Conn. labor markets.
newsitem.headline: Breakdown of jobless rate for Conn. labor markets.

text.p: The following list provides a breakdown of the March jobless rates in Connecticut's main labor markets, based on data that were not seasonally adjusted, according to the state Department of Labor.
The state's overall unemployment rate was 4.9 percent, when measured on a seasonally adjusted basis.
--Bridgeport, 5.9 pct, down from 6.5 pct in Feb and 6.8 pct a year ago.
--Danbury, 3.3 pct, down from 3.7 pct in Feb and 4.0 pct a year-ago.
--Danielson, 6.3 pct, down from 6.8 pct in Feb and 7.6 pct a year-ago.
--Hartford, 5.5 pct, down from 6.0 pct in Feb and 6.3 pct a year-ago.
--Lower River, 4.1 pct, down from 4.7 pct in Feb and 4.7 cpt a year-ago.
--New Haven, 5.0 pct, down from 5.5 pct in Feb and 6.0 pct a year-ago.
--New London, 5.1 pct, down from 5.8 pct in Feb and 5.6 pct a year-ago.
--Stamford, 3.2 pct, down from 3.5 pct in Feb and 3.9 pct a year-ago.
--Torrington, 4.7 pct, down from 5.2 pct in Feb and 5.8 pct a year-ago.
--Waterbury, 6.2 pct, down from 6.6 pct in Feb and 6.9 pct a year-ago.
